zh: 另一台电脑可以当「运行机」：上面的客户端都用这台的 FULI，记忆只存一份。
运行机发起的请求在这台电脑上一律只读；被撤销就立刻停用，还没送到的记录会留着。
主机不在时，运行机约 5 秒内应答，任务记录先排队，连上后补交、只记一次。
en: Another computer can be a runner: its clients use this computer's FULI, with one memory.
A runner's asks stay read-only here; a revoked runner stops at once and keeps what it had not sent.
With the host away a runner answers in about 5 s and queues checkpoints, delivered once later.
